ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels localized centrally and 65% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white pigmentation forming a 'V' shape originating at the peduncle and extending into the mid-lobes, bounded by a continuous black margin at the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing edge, with prominent peaks and valleys exceeding 5-pixel amplitude at this resolution.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to a convex upward sweep at the distal margins (tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters embedded within the central white pigmentation area, most prominent on the right interior lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical dark linear streaks (rake marks) disrupting the white pigmentation on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/indentation on the distal margin of the right lobe tip, presenting as an asymmetrical deep notch.
